messages:
ops-bot: Pager opened: HIGH latency spike affecting generation p95 in eu-west-1, affected route: /v1/generate. Alert id: INC-2026-8743 :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Symptoms: 4xx/5xx ratio up, p95 token latency 2.3s -> 8.9s, error spike at 2026-06-12T18:12Z. Auto-escalation to on-call.
alex: I'm primary for this shift, taking lead. Maya you're on secondary. Jordan you can assist if we need infra-level rollbacks.
maya: on it, joining console now. checking recent deploys and autoscaler events.
jordan: looking at GPU pool metrics. seeing one node pool (g-enc-std-8) with high CPU steal and load around 95%. Could be noisy neighbor or bad kernel patch.
alex: observing increased KV cache miss rate simultaneously. suspecting a spike in cold-starts + kernel stall. Noticed a canary deploy rolled at 18:08 in eu-west-1 for model-quant-opt v2.2.
maya: confirming deploy history: v2.2 canary started 18:07 -> 18:10 controlled rollout. Rolling back canary now to rule it out.
maya: Command: 
```
redwood-deploy rollback --region eu-west-1 --service generation --to-tag v2.1-canary
```
ops-bot: Rollback started, job id rb-8891. Expected completion ~2m.
alex: Routing changes: diverting region traffic to eu-central-1 for new requests to reduce immediate customer impact. Applying soft-failover policy.
jordan: Runbook check: under /runbooks/latency_spike -> step 3 says check active kernel patches, step 5 suggests rolling back canaries and throttling autoscaler. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency_spike
sam: FYI, hit an elevated rate of 429s at 18:14 from one high-volume customer (acct_2345). Reached out to AM to notify.
maya: Rollback completed at 18:16. Monitoring metrics... p95 dropped to 3.1s and falling. Errors still around 2%.
alex: Good. Keeping traffic diversion for 15m to let caches warm and KV prefix cache refill.
jordan: I see one GPU host with OOM logs around 18:09, but not sure if it's cause or effect. Collected logs and uploaded to /infra/logs/INC-2026-8743/gpu-oom.log
sam: Customer impact summary so far: ~12% of requests in eu-west-1 saw >5s latency window between 18:10-18:20. Estimated affected API calls ~4.2k. No data loss, all requests eventually responded or returned transient error.
alex: Current status: rollback done, traffic partially diverted, warm-up in progress. Actions for next shift: 1) confirm autoscaler policy for g-enc-std-8 pool, 2) follow up on kernel patch rollouts and hold further canaries, 3) run a targeted workload test to validate stability.
maya: added action items in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-8743. Assigned tasks -> jordan (infra postmortem), sam (customer comms), alex (follow-up on deploy gating).
jordan: I'll snapshot the problematic node and run fio/cpu isolation tests. Plan to try repro in staging with similar traffic pattern.
sam: Sent preliminary comms to affected customer and support triage channel, noting mitigation and ETA for full resolution (~30m).
alex: Handoff notes for next on-call (in ~30m): you will be primary, secondary is maya. Coverage gap: overnight eu-west deep-health checks are thinner after 22:00, consider scheduling an extra health-run if we see regression. Runbooks: latency_spike, autoscaler_tuning, gpunode_diagnostics.
maya: added sticky note to calendar for a follow-up sync at 19:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Incident update logged: status -> mitigated (partial). Next update required by 18:46Z or on significant change.
alex: Thanks team. If anything spikes again, escalate to SRE rota and ping pager duty. :thumbsup:
maya: Passing primary now to jordan for the late-evening window. I'll be available as secondary.
jordan: Acknowledged, taking over. I'll continue monitoring and start the infra postmortem draft.
sam: I'll follow up on customer comms and update the incident doc with exact counts and rollback timeline.
alex: Brief summary for handoff message: 1) Root cause suspected: canary deploy + one noisy GPU host -> rollback mitigated. 2) Customer impact: transient high latency for ~4.2k calls, partial 429s. 3) Next steps: infra postmortem, tighten deploy gating, run targeted warm-up. 4) Primary now: jordan; Secondary: maya.
jordan: logging handoff ack. will post a short blameless timeline in the doc in the next 20m.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-8743: last update 18:28Z, state=monitoring.
